description: Geographic point the story is about
prompt: A [latitude, longitude] pair: exactly two numbers, latitude -90..90, longitude -180..180.
notes: The schema uses draft 2020-12 tuple validation with `prefixItems` to ensure the value is an array of exactly two numbers. The first number is constrained to the latitude range of -90 to 90, and the second to the longitude range of -180 to 180.
